calls.name: Parameter
calls.evidence: Both the 2025 and 2026 iLogic help pages document the Parameter("parameterName") function for reading and changing parameter values, with no deprecation or removal notice.
calls.sourceQuote: This function changes parameter values directly.
calls.note: Documentation covers 2025 and 2026, not 2027.2 specifically, but nothing marks Parameter as deprecated or removed.
calls.query: Inventor iLogic and API reference Parameter Inventor 2027.2

calls.name: iLogicVb.UpdateWhenDone
calls.evidence: The iLogic Document Functions reference documents iLogicVb.UpdateWhenDone = True as updating the document after the rule finishes running, and the 2026 help repeats this usage, with no deprecation noted.
calls.note: It is documented as a property set to True rather than a method, but it is available and not marked deprecated; the docs cover 2022-2026, not 2027.2 specifically.
